gloss: reading room (in a library or archive)

definitions.gloss: reading room (in a library or archive)
definitions.explanation: A designated room in libraries, archives, or institutions where visitors can read or consult materials.

examples.japanese: {閲覧室|えつらんしつ}は{静|しず}かにしてください。
examples.english: Please be quiet in the reading room.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}の{閲覧室|えつらんしつ}で{勉強|べんきょう}した。
examples.english: I studied in the library's reading room.

examples.japanese: この{資料|しりょう}は{閲覧室|えつらんしつ}でのみ{利用|りよう}できます。
examples.english: These materials can only be used in the reading room.

notes:
A compound of {閲覧|えつらん} (reading/browsing) and {室|しつ} (room). Found in libraries, archives, museums, and other institutions where reference materials are available for on-site consultation. Signs reading {閲覧室|えつらんしつ} are common in Japanese libraries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閲覧室|えつらんしつ}を{利用|りよう}する: to use the reading room
- {閲覧室|えつらんしつ}で{閲覧|えつらん}する: to browse/read in the reading room
- {一般|いっぱん}{閲覧室|えつらんしつ}: general reading room
- {特別|とくべつ}{閲覧室|えつらんしつ}: special collections reading room

RELATED WORDS:
- {閲覧|えつらん}: reading, browsing — the act itself
- {書庫|しょこ}: stacks, book storage — where books are stored (as opposed to read)
